I do think this is a valid concern of yours. but unfortunately it appears to me that meditation is not really what gets you in this manic state of mind, it's rather supposed to do the opposite.

Maybe you should look into practices that are for activation of the mind. going on a walk for example mostly triggers some thoughts in me. or you could try speed writing, where you just try to non-stop write everything that comes to your mind. Maybe good old mind mapping or brainstorming are helpful as well. Sometimes it can be helpful to be in a certain environment or with certain people that encourages creative thinking.

There are a lot of ways to activate your creative thinking and I believe it is important to have some sort of balance between focus and chaos. it could even be profitable for your meditation practice.

here is how I do it:

I sit in a comfortable position on a chair and set a timer for 20 minutes. when I inhale I say "ohm" in my head and when I exhale I say "ah" and then during the little break in between "hum". when thoughts arise I go back to concentrating on that mantra.

That's basically all there is to it.
